title: ProtocolSchema
description: Schema root used to generate the checked-in language-neutral contract.

workingDirectory.description:
None resets to the application-owned per-thread directory. A custom
directory must be an absolute, existing directory on this machine.

lastMessageAt.description: Latest actual message activity, absent for message-free threads.

lastUserMessageAt.description: Latest user submission. Streaming output does not advance sidebar order.

frontend.description: Stable front-end identifier selected when the sidecar was launched.

chatCwd.description: Canonical parent of application-owned, per-thread desktop workspaces.

permissionProfile.description: Default permission profile for a new desktop chat (Agent starts off).

newThreadSettings.description:
Settings `AxiomCLI` will apply to the next thread. On a clean profile the
thinking level is `medium`; afterward these are the last-used values.

PromptMetadata.description:
Metadata Axiom Desktop attaches beneath the standard ACP `_meta.axiom`
namespace when submitting a user message.

webEnabled.description:
Explicit per-message desktop consent to external web tools. Never
inherited from an earlier turn, saved thread, or permission profile.

agentRevision.description: Bind queued input to the exact locally approved Agent configuration.

revision.description:
Replace local history starting at this user message before the normal
native E2EE turn. Never interpreted by the hosted backend.

data.description: Canonical base64, without a data-URL prefix. Remote URLs are not images.

FileContent.description: Original file bytes. Extraction belongs to the attested provider, not Axiom.

DeliveryMetadata.description:
Durable identity attached beneath `_meta.axiom` on standard ACP
notifications. Content still belongs exclusively to standard ACP; this
metadata lets a client reconcile it with an authoritative timeline page.

lastMessageAt.description: Latest actual message activity; operational updates do not advance it.

lastUserMessageAt.description: Latest user submission. Streaming output does not advance sidebar order.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

activeTurnId.description: Active durable turn, including when a client missed its start event.

ContextUsage.description:
Last provider-reported conversation request, not a measurement of the next
request or a cumulative billing total. Auxiliary title/compaction requests
never replace this report. Limits describe the model used by that request.

RequestUsage.description:
Decimal strings remain exact in JavaScript, on disk, and over ACP.
A settled charge does not imply an authenticated/complete model response.

revision.description:
Monotonic within one agent runtime. Clients must ignore account states
whose revision is not newer than the state they already applied.
Monotonic within one agent runtime; clients ignore older projections.

PaymentAccount.description:
Payment-service values remain exact decimal strings across Rust/ACP/JS.
Nested fields retain the backend's `snake_case` HTTP contract.

ZecUsdQuote.description: Indicative live market price; deposit credit uses its confirmation-time rate.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for calendar boundaries. Omitted clients retain UTC/all-time behavior.

costMicrousd.description: Exact USD millionths; never an IEEE-754 amount.

PrewarmSecurityRequest.description: Model-only warmup: no thread, prompt, inference, or implicit consent.

attestationGeneration.description: Relay lease generation, when the provider protocol uses relay leases.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 time recorded by `AxiomCLI` when the outward event was created.
